# Play Mine

> High-resolution lossless music player created by Sanchar Koirala, featuring real-time cloud track synchronization, a 32-bit Float Web Audio API mastering DSP engine, and WebGL2 GPU spectrum visualization.

## Core Architecture
- **Dual-Engine Lossless Audio**: Automatically negotiates 32-bit Float Web Audio DSP (5-band Biquad EQ, Mid/Side stereo soundstage widener, and transparent clip limiter) for CORS-enabled streams and direct hardware native DAC playback for external audio hosts.
- **GPU-Accelerated Visualization**: Offloads real-time spectrum rendering to dedicated graphics hardware via a custom WebGL2 GLSL fragment shader (`Aurora`, `Bars`, and `Wave` modes).
- **Realtime Cloud Sync**: Synchronizes published tracks instantaneously from Firebase Realtime Database (`play_mine/tracks`).

## Canonical Entry Points
- `https://play-mine.pages.dev/`: Public music player, DSP mastering rack, GPU spectrum visualizer, and cloud track vault.
- `https://play-mine.pages.dev/manifest.json`: Progressive Web App (PWA) manifest.
